output.review_comment: The implementation adds special-case logic (linear interpolation for even-length arrays with p=50) that directly contradicts the docstring, which explicitly states "values are never averaged or interpolated." The teammate said docstrings are the source of truth. Either the docstring must be updated to document the interpolation behavior, or the implementation should follow the docstring strictly and accept that one test will fail due to a test/spec mismatch.
